items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: as Richard Tee used to say to me, “You’re doing the homework, Stuffy.”

ctx.x: Well in a general sense I’m thinking of the big picture. I know that musicians get a lot of gigs from referrals and let’s say it’s a given that Chris Parker is a good drummer, but there must be something else that you would rise above all the other fine drummers. Maybe what you bring to a session or what you don’t bring. Can you work with that question?

Sure. When I get a call my focus is immediately gratitude — oh my God I’m going to get to play music with these people or this artist or this singer. And I’m immediately excited about it and from the moment I get the call I start to do homework — as Richard Tee used to say to me, “You’re doing the homework, Stuffy.” And I research that artist, listen to everything I can find that they’ve recorded previously. Maybe most importantly listen to their last record or look at their last performance somehow and I take…
Have you ever had someone say to you, “I don’t want you to do that.”?
